textos.titulo: Digital Linu: video, social media and ads for your business
textos.descricao: Video editing, Reels, Instagram management, paid ads, Google Business Profile, brand identity and customer service automation. Build your package and ask for a quote on WhatsApp.
textos.og_descricao: Video, social media, ads, branding and automation for small businesses. From the team behind Linu Sites.
textos.og_imagem_alt: Linu, the pixel-art penguin, holding a camera on the monitor of a video editor, above a timeline with coloured tracks, next to the name Digital Linu and the line: your business showing up where people look
textos.faixa_texto: Part of the Linu family, with Linu Sites, Linu Seguro and Linu Farol.
textos.ab_titulo: Your business showing up where people look
textos.ab_sub: Video, social media, ads, branding and automation, all from one team. Pick the clips your business needs, build the sequence and get your quote on WhatsApp.
textos.linu_alt: Linu in the viewfinder, camera in hand, ready to take the photo
textos.tomada_1: Take 1: Linu ready for the shot.
textos.rx_sub: Eight yes-or-no questions. With each answer, the X-ray shows what is missing and why, and you add it to your package with one tap.
textos.rxp_maps: Can people searching on Google Maps find your business, with opening hours and photos?
textos.rxp_perfil: Does your Instagram have a clear bio, highlights and the right link?
textos.rxp_posta: Do you post at least once a week?
textos.rxp_video: Do you already publish short videos (Reels, Shorts, TikTok)?
textos.rxp_anuncio: Do you already advertise on Instagram or Google?
textos.rxp_marca: Does your brand have a logo and set colours?
textos.rxp_whats: Does everyone who messages you on WhatsApp get a reply the same day?
textos.rxp_site: Does your business have a website?
textos.rx_vazio: Answer the questions: whatever shows up here is what is missing most.
textos.rx_site: No website? Linu Sites, from the same team, builds it alongside.
textos.sv_sub: Each service is a clip. Tap Add and it goes into your sequence, with the estimate adding up, and the quote message writes itself.
textos.sv_nota: Reference prices, “from”. The exact price comes in the proposal, in writing. Ad spend is separate and goes straight to Meta or Google.
textos.st_reels: Short vertical videos, cut to the beat, with captions and music: from script to edit, or just the edit of what you filmed.
textos.st_youtube: Long videos edited: cuts, music, titles, thumbnail and chapters.
textos.st_institucional: A video that introduces the company, the place and the team, for the website, social media and presentations.
textos.st_cortes: Live streams, classes and podcasts become several short videos, captioned for people watching without sound.
textos.st_gestao: The month’s calendar, posts, captions and publishing, with a simple report on what worked.
textos.st_artes: Templates in your brand’s look, so you can post day to day without starting from scratch.
textos.st_perfil: Clear bio, photo, highlights, the right link and the first pinned posts: a profile ready for visitors.
textos.st_identidade: Logo, colours, typefaces and a short usage guide, so everything the brand publishes matches.
textos.st_cartao: A pocket-sized page with contact details, social media and address, to share by link or QR code.
textos.st_cardapio: The menu on your customer’s phone from the QR code on the table, easy to update when prices change.
textos.st_meta: Meta campaigns for your area and your audience, with the budget you set and a report every month.
textos.st_google_ads: Show up at the top of search when someone looks for what you sell, paying only for clicks.
textos.st_meu_negocio: Your full profile on Google Maps: opening hours, photos, services, replies to reviews and posts.
textos.st_seo: Titles, descriptions and copy on your website adjusted so Google understands what you do and where.
textos.st_whatsapp: Welcome message, quick replies, catalogue and labels, so no customer goes unanswered.
textos.st_email: Contact list, email templates and scheduled sends: news, offers and reminders.
textos.st_ia: An assistant that answers common questions on your website or WhatsApp and hands over to a person when needed.
textos.seq_vazia: Empty sequence. Add a clip or choose a ready-made package.
textos.pc_sub: Sequences that tend to work well together. Choose one and change whatever you like before asking.
textos.pc_comecar_t: For those who barely show up online yet.
textos.pc_crescer_t: To stay consistent on social media and bring in new people every month.
textos.pc_completo_t: Brand, social media, ads and customer service moving together.
textos.pc_site_t: Need a website too? Linu Sites is the same team: the website comes together with the Google Business Profile and the SEO.
textos.tb_sub: What the team has made and can show. Client work appears here with each client’s permission.
textos.tb_familia_t: Linu in pixel art, the colours, the typefaces and each website’s object: LinuPedia’s notebook, Linu Sites’ Antarctic station and the editing suite here. (Page in Portuguese.)
textos.tb_sites_t: Websites built by the same team, live, each with a page telling how it was made.
textos.tb_clientes_t: The video, the profile before and after and the number that changed, for every client who lets us show it. Want to be one of the first? Ask for a quote.
textos.como_sub: Like an editing timeline: each step is a segment, and nothing goes live without your approval.
textos.passo_1_t: You tell us about the business, the audience and what you want to achieve. It can be just an idea.
textos.passo_2_t: The plan arrives in writing, with what is included, the timeline and the price of each part.
textos.passo_3_t: The team for each area does its part, and you approve before it goes live.
textos.passo_4_t: For monthly services, a report each month with the numbers and next steps.
textos.faq_custa_r: Each service shows its “from” price, and the package adds up as you go: what is a one-off delivery (a logo, a company video) and what is monthly (management, ads). The exact price comes in the proposal, in writing, with no commitment.
textos.faq_verba_r: No. The money that goes to Meta or Google is yours and is paid straight to them, on your card. The service covers setting up, monitoring and adjusting the campaigns.
textos.faq_tudo_p: Do I have to take everything?
textos.faq_tudo_r: No. You can ask for a single service. The packages are suggestions, and you change whatever you like.
textos.faq_fidelidade_r: Only a 3-month minimum for ads and automation, which need setting up at the start. After that, and for the other monthly services from day one, it is month to month: to stop, just give 30 days’ notice, with no penalty.
textos.faq_pagamento_r: One-off delivery: half when you accept the proposal and half on delivery. Monthly: at the start of each month. You get an invoice in euros and pay by SEPA transfer through Wise. Between businesses, where it applies, VAT is under the reverse charge: the buyer accounts for it in their own country.
textos.faq_revisoes_r: Two rounds of changes on each delivery (a video, a logo, the month’s designs). Fixing our own mistakes does not count.
textos.faq_gravo_p: Do I film the videos myself?
textos.faq_gravo_r: Yes: you film on your phone, with a script and tips from the team, and get the edited video back. On-site filming by the team is available in Brazil only.
textos.faq_fora_p: Do you work with clients outside Brazil?
textos.faq_fora_r: Yes. Everything is done remotely, in English or Portuguese, with calls arranged for your time zone. We are based in Brazil (UTC−3), and replies come within one business day.
textos.ct_texto: Check your package, tell us a little about the business and send it through the form (the reply comes to your email) or on WhatsApp, with the message already written.
textos.ct_email: Your email (for the reply to the form)
textos.ct_telefone: Your WhatsApp (optional, so we can reply there)
textos.ct_mais_ex: What you want to achieve, deadline, links to your social media…
textos.ct_privacidade: When you send it, your request (name, email, WhatsApp, business, what you chose and the message) is kept for 12 months only so we can reply, and is then deleted. To see or delete it earlier: contato@linupedia.com.br.
textos.rodape:
Digital Linu: video, social media, ads, branding and automation.
From the team behind Linu Sites and LinuPedia.

js.rx_maps: People searching on Google Maps cannot find you yet: this is the first step, and the cheapest.
js.rx_perfil: The profile is your shop window: people arriving from an ad or a Reel decide there whether to follow.
js.rx_posta: Without consistency, Instagram shows your posts to fewer people. Monthly management takes care of the calendar.
js.rx_video: Short video is what best takes your profile to people who do not follow you yet.
js.rx_anuncio: A small, well-targeted ad budget brings in people from your area in the very first month.
js.rx_marca: A logo and set colours make everything you publish look like the same brand.
js.rx_whats: A quick reply on WhatsApp is a customer who does not go to a competitor.
